reviewNotes: Reviewed all 451 distinct exported speech keys from 100 cards against data/real-conversation-400-2.json vocabulary readings and source furigana. Sentence/cloze prompts and full-sentence correct-answer explanations use 1.0; standalone vocabulary and short combined choices use 0.85. Topic/contrast は -> わ checked by exact key and occurrence, including では. Lexical しはらい, はらいました, はんばい/はんばいちゅう, はいります, はじめて/はじめました, はつおん, はなす/はなします, はこぶ, はっぴょう, はやく and はなび retained. No directional へ occurs; lexical へんぴん, へや, へんこう and へんか preserved. Object を -> お checked in context. Source 感じ(かんじ) remains kanji in three exported choice keys because the exporter only handles per-kanji furigana; those exact reviewed inputs use かんじ, matching the source reading and the explanation. Katakana converted to hiragana preserving long vowels and small kana (れしーと, かーど, さいず, あくせんと, えあこん, ほてる, たいぷ, いべんと, ほーむすてい). Final punctuation added to fragments. Display labels and distinct lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified. Explanations removed from all vocabulary-only cards at the user’s request. Retained exactly the existing reviewed prompts, choice lists and vocabulary recordings.
